releases.body:
Maintenance release.

- Trusted npm publishing validated through protected GitHub Actions OIDC
- Release verification and maintainer documentation added
- CI and publishing workflows hardened with immutable action pins
- Publishing workflow now uses npm 11.18.0

Initial public release of OpenCode Harness Panel.

- Focused skills and subagent session introspection
- Privacy-safe optional tool activity and provenance
- Configurable, collapsible sidebar sections
- Verified npm consumer tarball installation
